cases.name: get returns the stored note; defaults applied
title length counts code points (200 ok, 201 rejected)
unicode, quotes and SQL-like text stored verbatim
patch tag null clears it; title/body null rejected
delete then get is 404, second delete is 404
ids are never reused after delete
list returns all notes ordered by id
search is a literal, case-sensitive substring of title or body
search: plus is a space, empty q lists all
405 for wrong method, 404 for unknown path
parallel creates all get distinct ids
